verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes the implementation-relevant rule that rendered captions use color to stand out; administrative details are excluded.
First concrete failure: the reviewed captions lacked the required color.
The client changes caption rendering to white-only text, the exact brand font, and no text effects; updating caption_color leaves no stale conflicting key.
Distinct concrete failure: the reviewed captions had the wrong font and required correction to white text without text effects.
First concrete post-correction verification: the client confirms the revised caption is good after being asked specifically about it.
The client adds a concrete visual acceptance condition requiring caption lettering to match the supplied reference videos; no prior key becomes obsolete.
The client adds the concrete caption-rendering rule that no black shadow appear behind the text; no stale conflicting key requires removal.
Distinct later failure mode: reviewed captions visibly contained a black shadow that required removal.
Target-specific implementation claim: the freelancer explicitly reports removing the caption text's black outline after the shadow correction request.
The client adds the concrete visual-stability rule that caption text remain fixed rather than moving vertically; no existing key becomes stale.
First concrete placement-stability failure: the reviewed caption text moved up and down instead of remaining fixed.
First concrete post-correction verification: the client approves the revised clips submitted after the uniquely identified caption-position correction.
